name: pi-whisper-stt
description: STT provider for the on-host whisper-server. Implements the `SttProvider` contract from `pi-telegram-echo`; registers with id `pi-whisper-stt`. Talks `POST /inference` with multipart `file` + `language` + `response_format`. Env vars: WHISPER_SERVER_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8080), PI_TELEGRAM_LANG (default yue).
